question: What was the return on investment (ROI) for Applied Materials, Inc. if $100 was invested in the company's common stock on October 27, 2013, and sold two years later, considering the cumulative total stockholder return as presented in the performance graph of the 2018 report?
retrieval_query: Applied Materials, Inc. return on investment ROI October 27 2013 two years later cumulative total stockholder return 2018 report
answer:
The return on investment (ROI) for Applied Materials, Inc. is calculated using the performance graph data from the 2018 report. The graph shows the cumulative total stockholder return for Applied common stock from October 27, 2013, to October 28, 2018. 

Given that $100 was invested on October 27, 2013, and the value of the stock on October 28, 2018, is $171.11 (as shown in the performance graph), the return is:

$171.11 - $100 = $71.11

ROI = ($71.11 / $100) × 100% = 71.11%

Source: finqa_test_ctx_7.pdf p.1
